name: ARCON Privileged Access Management
notes: Reference implementation. 122 API modules across 70 controllers.
catalogueBasis: distinct (controller, action) pairs. The same file also yields 1,336 (all public static String declarations, including header and verb constants), 1,321 (/api/ declarations with duplicates) and 1,308 (distinct path strings). Quote 1,306.
coverageBasis: 1,140 of the 1,388 endpoints reached are declared in APIConfig.java, against a catalogue of 1,306. The other 248 come from the QA team's Excel test corpus, which contains endpoints the catalogue does not declare — so 'reached' and 'declared' are different populations and their raw ratio is not a coverage figure.
performanceTrend: mean down, median down, p95 up
